def caseJ():
    """retune after restore scales from the RESTORED rho; checkpoint keeps its own pair."""
    req = {'cases': [{'nodes': 2, 'edges': [[0, 1, 1]],
                      'commodities': [{'source': 0, 'sink': 1, 'demand': 6, 'paths': [[0]]}],
                      'workers': [[0]], 'quorum': 1, 'max_lag': 9, 'relax': [1, 1], 'rho': 2,
                      'mode': 'route',
                      'events': [{'op': 'issue', 'id': 0, 'worker': 0}, {'op': 'deliver', 'id': 0},
                                 {'op': 'step'},                       # X=6, rho=2 -> h=5.5,u=0.5
                                 {'op': 'save', 'name': 0},
                                 {'op': 'retune', 'rho': 8},           # u = 0.5*2/8 = 0.125
                                 {'op': 'audit'},
                                 {'op': 'restore', 'name': 0},         # rho=2, u=0.5 again
                                 {'op': 'audit'},
                                 {'op': 'retune', 'rho': 4},           # u = 0.5*2/4 = 0.25
                                 {'op': 'audit'},
                                 {'op': 'restore', 'name': 0},
                                 {'op': 'retune', 'rho': 1},           # u = 0.5*2/1 = 1.0
                                 {'op': 'audit'}]}]}
    ev = run(req)['cases'][0]['events']
    close(ev[2]['ceiling'], 5.5, 'J ceiling')
    close(ev[2]['dual'][0], 0.5, 'J dual')
    close(ev[4]['dual'][0], 0.125, 'J retuned dual')
    assert ev[4]['rho'] == 8
    assert ev[5]['generation'] == 1
    close(ev[6]['dual'][0], 0.5, 'J restored dual')
    assert ev[6]['rho'] == 2
    close(ev[8]['dual'][0], 0.25, 'J retune after restore')
    assert ev[8]['rho'] == 4
    assert ev[9]['generation'] == 2
    close(ev[11]['dual'][0], 1.0, 'J second retune after restore')
    assert ev[11]['rho'] == 1
    close(ev[11]['z'][0], 5.5, 'J z survives retunes')
    print('caseJ ok')
